svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="ElQMJ-PwxvGZU0vOrkHY"> <mxGraphModel dx="1308" dy="772" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
	autonumber
	actor Client
	participant AC as Auth<br/>Controller
	participant AS as Authorisation<br/>ServiceImpl
	participant ATE as Authorisation<br/>Transactional<br/>ExecutorImpl
	participant AR as Authorisation<br/>Repository
	participant AER as Authorisation<br/>EventRepository
	participant AccR as Account<br/>Repository
	participant OES as OutboxEvent<br/>ServiceImpl

	Client->>AC: POST /authorisations/{id}/captures
	AC->>AS: capture(authorisationId,<br/>captureRequest)
	AS->>ATE: captureInTransaction(authorisationId,<br/>captureRequest)

	ATE->>AR: findById(authorisationId)
	AR-->>ATE: AuthorisationEntity

	alt status == CAPTURED
		ATE->>AER: findByAccountIdAndEventTypeAndIdempotencyKey(accountId,<br/>idemKey, AUTHORISATION_CAPTURED)
		alt capture event exists for idempotency key
			AER-->>ATE: existing capture event
			ATE-->>AS: previous CaptureResponse
		else capture key mismatch
			ATE-->>AS: throw IdempotencyConflictException
		end
	else status != AUTHORISED
		ATE-->>AS: throw AuthorisationIllegalStateException
	else status == AUTHORISED
		ATE->>AccR: findById(accountId)
		AccR-->>ATE: AccountEntity
		ATE->>ATE: account.capture(amount, currency)
		ATE->>ATE: set authorisation status = CAPTURED

		ATE->>AR: saveAndFlush(authorisation CAPTURED)
		ATE->>AER: saveAndFlush(event AUTHORISATION_CAPTURED)
		ATE->>OES: enqueueAuthorisation(...,<br/>OperationType.CAPTURE)
		OES->>OES: build CAPTURE payload map
		OES->>OES: save outbox event (status NEW)
		ATE-->>AS: CaptureResponse
	end

	alt Concurrent capture insert race
		ATE-->>AS: throw ConcurrentIdempotencyRaceException
		AS->>AR: findById(authorisationId)
		AS->>AER: findByAccountIdAndEventTypeAndIdempotencyKey(accountId,<br/>idemKey, AUTHORISATION_CAPTURED)
		alt capture event found
			AS-->>AC: recovered CaptureResponse
		else
			AS-->>AC: IdempotencyConflictException
		end
	else Concurrent account-version conflict<br/>(different idempotency key)
		ATE-->>AS: throw AccountConcurrencyConflictException
		AS-->>AC: 409 Conflict (retry hint)
	else No race
		AS-->>AC: CaptureResponse
	end

	AC-->>Client: 200 OK / error

",
 "config": null
